page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2gne.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance features 8 vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. A key hardware characteristic is the inclusion of 959 GB of bundled local SSD storage. The network interface provides a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that the ecs.i2gne.2xlarge exhibits modest processing and memory performance. In stress-ng and Geekbench tests, both single-core and multi-core CPU performance fall into the bottom 25% tier. Memory read bandwidth is also weak, though large-block write bandwidth reaches average levels. Cryptographic and compression tasks show limitations, with single-threaded gzip and bzip3 decompression scoring in the bottom 10%. However, Passmark CPU and extended instruction tests achieve average ratings, and LLM inference speeds for small 135M models remain in the middle 50% tier.

The primary tradeoff of this instance lies in its combination of dedicated CPU cores and a substantial 959 GB local SSD against lower overall compute and memory throughput. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the server offers a high density of local storage relative to its compute tier, making it suitable for workloads requiring local data caching or temporary storage rather than raw computational power. Appropriate workloads include basic database operations, local file processing, static web serving, and lightweight general-purpose applications that benefit from local SSD storage without demanding high CPU or memory bandwidth.
